title: Basketball Motor Imagery EEG Dataset
description: EEG recordings from 35 healthy participants performing three basketball-related motor observation and motor imagery tasks: single-handed dribbling, two-handed ball passing, and two-person passing. The dataset provides raw EEG, preprocessed data, and phase-locking value (PLV) functional connectivity results. It supports research on motor imagery, action observation, and interpersonal neural synchrony in sports-related contexts.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with an ANT Neuro system (64 channels, 1000 Hz sampling rate). Tasks included dribbling (5 conditions), ball passing (4 conditions), and two-person passing (4 combined observation/imagery conditions and 4 PLV conditions).
